Name: Kvark
ShortDescription: Kvark is an FPS game set in a fictional version of the 80s Czech Republic. The player finds themselves in an underground facility that is falling apart as they travel through it. They will have to navigate through dark tunnels and will encounter many obstacles and enemies that will test their skills

Name: Digimon Survive
ShortDescription: Este jogo apresenta um híbrido de romance visual e RPG tático localizado num mundo misterioso repleto de monstros perigosos e batalhas mortíferas que colocarão à prova a tua capacidade de sobrevivência.

Name: Mortal Kombat 11
ShortDescription: Esta lenda está de volta, melhor do que nunca, na mais recente evolução desta série lendária.

Name: Kong: Survivor Instinct
ShortDescription: Quando os monstros lutam, ninguém está a salvo. Embarca numa emocionante missão de sobrevivência numa cidade que agora é um campo de batalha para os Titãs. Usa a força letal dos Titãs a teu favor neste jogo oficial do “Monsterverse” que se passa depois dos eventos de Zilla vs. Kong.

Name: Need for Speed Payback
ShortDescription: O Need for Speed™ Payback - Deluxe Edition dá-te vantagem sobre a concorrência. Destaca-te da multidão com itens de personalização exclusivos e recebe descontos no jogo, bónus de Rep e cinco Shipments para começar a tua aventura.

Name: Orange Season
ShortDescription: Make your farmer’s dream come true in Orange Season. With your parent’s help, you’ve finally saved enough money to buy a plot of land in the charming farmer’s village of Orange Town. Build a thriving farm as you grow crops, raise animals, fish, and mine materials to establish your farm in town.

Name: Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond
ShortDescription: Prove your political brilliance in a grand strategy like no other: pick any contemporary country, set up your government and navigate the pitfalls of domestic and international politics. A glorious destiny awaits - the domination of not just the Earth, but the whole Solar system!

Name: Resident Evil: Requiem
ShortDescription: Requiem para os mortos. Pesadelo para os vivos. Prepara-te para fugir à morte nesta experiência de gelar o sangue.

Name: Tormenture
ShortDescription: Tormenture is a psychological horror game where you play as a child trapped in a cursed 8-bit game with a dark secret. To survive, you must find four relics and solve reality-blurring puzzles. But beware—some creatures may escape the game and haunt you in the real world. A game within a game.

Name: ITORAH
ShortDescription: Discover the world of Nahucan in this 2D action platformer. You are Itorah, the only human in this strange place. Explore, fight and survive to uncover your past and save Nahucan from its biggest threat, a mysterious plague!

Name: Void -Dementia-
ShortDescription: Action game Void Dementia is characterized by fast action and hardcore production, and is an action game that will amplify the user's sense of challenge and immersion in the game with the story and Roguelike elements of the void area.

Name: The Artful Escape
ShortDescription: A teenage guitar prodigy sets out on a psychedelic journey to inspire his stage persona and confront the legacy of a dead folk legend. Starring voice performances by Michael Johnston, Caroline Kinley, Lena Headey, Jason Schwartzman, Mark Strong, and Carl Weathers.

Name: Yugo: the non-game
ShortDescription: Yugo: o não-jogo é um espaço virtual onde você pode dirigir um carro, ouvir rádio e convidar pessoas para conversar e compartilhar a experiência.

Name: Thronefall
ShortDescription: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

Name: Loddlenaut
ShortDescription: Joga como um contínuo interestelar enviado para limpar um planeta aquático poluído. Apanha lixo, explora as vibrantes águas e cuida de criaturas alienígenas parecidas com axolotes!

Name: Bendy and the Ink Machine
ShortDescription: Bendy and the Ink Machine® is the first person puzzle action horror game that will forever ruin your childhood love of cartoons.

Name: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered
ShortDescription: Shadows of the Damned, o jogo de ação e aventura que se desenrola no inferno, agora numa edição remasterizada! Prepara-te para uma história sobre rock, amor e caça aos demónios.

Name: Kingdoms and Castles
ShortDescription: Kingdoms and Castles é um jogo sobre o crescimento de um reino a partir duma pequena aldeia e alastrando para uma cidade e magnífico castelo.

Name: HighFleet
ShortDescription: Battle for survival in the skies of a mysterious future Earth in this unique action-strategy game mixing arcade combat, exploration, management and diplomacy. As giant flying ships wage spectacular aerial warfare, a prophecy tells of one who will save the world – could it be you?

Name: Momodora: Moonlit Farewell
ShortDescription: "Momodora: Moonlit Farewell" is the latest installment in the Momodora series. Join Momo, High Priestess of the village of Koho, as she embarks on a divine mission to save her people from imminent destruction at the hands of the demon hordes summoned by a malevolent bellringer.

Name: Stone Story RPG
ShortDescription: An auto-RPG with strategic combat, deep crafting and programming elements, animated entirely in ASCII-art. In a realm of perpetual darkness, a single stone could change everything...

Name: Dead Estate
ShortDescription: Cornered with nowhere else to turn, can you escape the monster-filled mansion? Dead Estate is a gory, fast-paced, challenging roguelike shooter with a heavy emphasis on horror.

Name: Bō: Path of the Teal Lotus
ShortDescription: Flui graciosamente num colorido jogo de plataformas 2.5D desenhado à mão, inspirado no folclore japonês. Trava combates aéreos acrobáticos, desbloqueia habilidades místicas poderosas e explora um mundo mítico interligado ao tentares desvendar os mistérios da tua origem.

Name: GRIS
ShortDescription: Gris é uma jovem cheia de esperança perdida no seu próprio mundo. Ao processar uma experiência dolorosa, a maneira como lida com esses sentimentos irá manifestar-se no seu vestido, que lhe irá conceder habilidades úteis para explorar um mundo difuso.

Name: Metal Slug Tactics
ShortDescription: METAL SLUG está de volta com um estrondo! Mergulha neste dinâmico RPG tático com uma experiência roguelite empolgante: a icónica ação explosiva da série foi redefinida. Agarra nas tuas armas, reúne o teu esquadrão e conquista o campo de batalha para derrotares o infame Exército Rebelde.

Name: Moon Mystery
ShortDescription: A Lua está assombrada e, quando um astronauta perde o contato com a Terra, a aventura começa em grande estilo. Encha o seu oxigênio, carregue as armas e parta para uma aventura FPS interestelar pelo cosmo, repleta de desafios, lutas, exploração e estranhos segredos do universo.

Name: Surviving the Abyss
ShortDescription: Earth, 1976. You have been tasked with managing a deep-sea science facility working to perfect cloning. Explore the darkness and keep your crew alive in this hardcore survival colony builder. And beware. The darkness hides untold horrors.

Name: Age of Wonders 4
ShortDescription: Governe um reino de fantasia criado por você! Explore novos reinos mágicos na combinação característica de Age of Wonders de estratégia e combate tático em turnos 4X. Controle uma facção que cresce e muda conforme você expande seu império a cada rodada!

Name: DEAD OR ALIVE 5 Last Round: Core Fighters
ShortDescription: A versão gratuita da última palavra em combate de entretenimento - DEAD OR ALIVE 5 Last Round!

Name: Taiko no Tatsujin Rhythm Festival
ShortDescription: Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival é um jogo de ritmo de percussão com canções de géneros como Anime e VOCALOID™, além de vários modos de jogo! Diverte-te a jogar a solo ou online!

Name: Haven
ShortDescription: Construa sua fazenda e relacionamentos com os habitantes da cidade ou siga em frente em uma busca de magia, monstros e dragões. Suba de nível em uma árvore de habilidades no modo multijogador para 8 pessoas ou aventure-se sozinho!

Name: Tower Factory
ShortDescription: Tower Factory is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

Name: ZEPHON
ShortDescription: Dos criadores de Warhammer 40,000: Gladius, ZEPHON é um jogo de estratégia 4X pós-apocalíptico com o sistema de combate único da Proxy. Guia sobreviventes por um futuro sombrio, vence desastres inesperados, horrores terríveis e monstros cibernéticos. O que farás para sobreviver?

Name: BATTLETECH
ShortDescription: Take command of your own mercenary outfit of 'Mechs and the MechWarriors that pilot them, struggling to stay afloat as you find yourself drawn into a brutal interstellar civil war.

Name: Total Tank Simulator
ShortDescription: PATENTE DE COMANDANTE. CORAÇÃO DE SOLDADO. Escolha uma facção, mobilize e comande seu exército em enormes batalhas com física realista na Segunda Guerra Mundial. Destrua tudo com uma incrível quantidade de unidades, que têm comportamento tático.

Name: Ecosystem
ShortDescription: Create virtual lifeforms whose development is shaped by a deep simulation of evolution. Guide them as they fight, mate, and adapt to the environment you have built. All the creatures in the trailer evolved on their own in the game!

Name: Curse of the Dead Gods
ShortDescription: Procuras riquezas incalculáveis, a vida eterna, poderes divinos - isso leva-te a este templo amaldiçoado, um labirinto aparentemente infinito de poços sem fundo, armadilhas mortíferas e monstros.

Name: Ghost Watchers
ShortDescription: Ghost Watchers is a co-op online horror game. You will explore and hunt ghosts in abandoned houses

Name: Praey for the Gods
ShortDescription: Praey for the Gods is a boss climbing open world adventure game where you play a lone hero sent to the edge of a dying frozen land to explore and solve the secrets of a never ending winter. Grapple, glide and grab hold of massive beasts as you fight to survive and return the world to proper order.

Name: ShapeHero Factory
ShortDescription: In ShapeHero Factory, you’re the engineer of an ever-evolving paint-fuelled factory that spits out magical, shape-based warriors. Send them into battle - to death or glory - then build an even better factory on your next run.

Name: FIGHT KNIGHT
ShortDescription: FIGHT KNIGHT is a first-person dungeon-brawler! Grid-based dungeon crawling meets action-packed real time enemy encounters. Fight your way through puzzles and enemies to save those trapped in the Tower's eternal night!

Name: Revhead
ShortDescription: Revhead é um simulador de corridas onde tens de construir o teu próprio bólide. Começas a tua viagem numa aldeia australiana. Põe-te na pele dos Revheads australianos, malucos pelos motores! Podes comprar/vender carros e peças, arranjar/aperfeiçoar o teu carro para o torná-lo no mais rápido.

Name: Rubber Bandits
ShortDescription: Rubber Bandits é um jogo multiplayer criminosamente divertido para até 4 jogadores. Com 8 modos recheados de ação, os participantes irão roubar, brigar e correr até a linha de chegada com o maior saco de dinheiro para vencer!

Name: Sunkenland
ShortDescription: Get ready for a Waterworld-themed survival game with modular base building, sunken city scavenging, crafting, base defense, and invasions of NPC clans for resources and territory. Ready for the water apocalypse?

Name: While We Wait Here
ShortDescription: Share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end.

Name: The Saboteur
ShortDescription: Mina a autoridade.

Name: Is This Game Trying to Kill Me
ShortDescription: An old shack deep in a dense forest, a strange computer and a game that's trying to kill you!

Name: ServiceIT: You can do IT
ShortDescription: ⚡️Consertar eletrônicos 📈gerenciar empresa 💻desafiar o hacker... ServiceIT é um jogo de simulação onde você administra uma empresa de TI de serviço completo e realiza diagnósticos, reparos, infiltração de rede, programação, gerenciamento de servidores enquanto um hacker Anônimo sabota tudo

Name: Poly Bridge
ShortDescription: Unleash your engineering creativity with an engaging and fresh bridge-building simulator with all the bells and whistles. Enjoy hours of physics-based puzzle solving in the Campaign and then jump in the Sandbox to create your own bridge designs and puzzles!

Name: Poly Bridge 2
ShortDescription: O aclamado simulador de construção de pontes está de volta, e melhor do que nunca! Redescubra a sua criatividade de engenharia com ainda mais horas de diversão de quebrar a cabeça!

Name: Bite Night
ShortDescription: Bite Night is a comedic first-person horror game that explores the idea of what if the big bad monster was bad at their job of being scary.

Name: Carry The Glass
ShortDescription: Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer! Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges. Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles. Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

Name: Trainee Death Simulator
ShortDescription: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.

Name: WWE 2K24
ShortDescription: Conhece uma cativante narração dos grandes momentos de WrestleMania no 2K Showcase of the Immortals em WWE 2K24, onde podes reviver uma coleção com alguns dos confrontos mais inesquecíveis e definidores de carreiras.

Name: I Am Future: Cozy Apocalypse Survival
ShortDescription: I Am Future é um jogo de sobrevivência no qual você constrói um acampamento num terraço de uma cidade pós-apocalíptica inundada. Cuide de suas plantações, cozinhe, desmonte ferramentas para obter recursos, automatize as tarefas recrutando robôs fofinhos e descubra o mistério por trás da catástrofe.

Name: Catizens
ShortDescription: Inspired by RimWorld and The Sims, Catizens is a colony management simulation game where you watch over unique cats with quirky personalities, as you help them build and grow their settlement while exploring new lands, facing off against wildlife and overcoming the challenges of each environment.

Name: Exo One
ShortDescription: A strange signal... an alien craft... an interplanetary, gravity-defying journey through space and time.

Name: Factory Town
ShortDescription: Build, automate, and optimize a giant factory on 3D terrain using conveyor belts, trains, chutes, pipes, and airships. Sell your goods to nearby villages to expand their borders, increase happiness, and unlock even better technology!

Name: Crysis 3 Remastered
ShortDescription: Experience the single-player experience from the iconic first-person shooter, Crysis 3, optimized to take advantage of today's hardware in Crysis 3 Remastered.

Name: Crysis 2 Remastered
ShortDescription: Relive the legendary single-player campaign from the classic first-person shooter, Crysis 2, optimized for today's hardware in Crysis 2 Remastered.

Name: Crysis Remastered
ShortDescription: The classic first person shooter from Crytek is back with the action-packed gameplay, sandbox world, and thrilling epic battles you loved the first time around – now with remastered graphics optimized for a new generation of hardware.

Name: American Fugitive
ShortDescription: Uma abordagem moderna à ação clássica em sandbox. Implicado no assassinato do teu pai, terás de fazer tudo para descobrir o verdadeiro culpado. Enfrenta missões empolgantes para o mundo do crime - só não te deixes apanhar pelos polícias!

Name: Arma: Cold War Assault
ShortDescription: Bohemia Interactive's debut game published by Codemasters as Operation Flashpoint in 2001, became genre-defining combat military simulation and the No. 1 bestselling PC game around the world and has won many international awards, including “Game of The Year” and “Best Action Game”. Over 2 million copies have been sold since its release.

Name: Esports Life Tycoon
ShortDescription: Gira o seu próprio plantel esports, expanda a sua casa de jogo e derrote equipas lendárias tornando-se no melhor do mundo!

Name: King of Seas
ShortDescription: Noby e os seus amigos estão de volta num novo título de Doraemon: Story of Seasons! Cultiva colheitas, cria animais e usa as engenhocas especiais de Doraemon para ajudar os teus amigos numa história enternecedora e cheia de diversão para pessoas de todas as idades.

Name: Pizza Tower
ShortDescription: Pizza Tower is a fast paced 2D platformer, with an emphasis on movement, exploration and score attack. Featuring highly stylized pixel art inspired by the cartoons from the '90s, and a highly energetic soundtrack.

Name: Maid Cafe on Electric Street
ShortDescription: Maid Cafe on Electric Street is a leisurely maid cafe adventure set in the otaku haven of Nipponbashi, Osaka.

Name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist : Link Evolution
ShortDescription: Constrói o teu baralho com mais de 10.000 cartas e enfrenta os Duelistas mais famosos do universo de Yu-Gi-Oh!. Revive a história da série de animação original Yu-Gi-Oh! com Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS!

Name: Forgotten but Unbroken
ShortDescription: A tactical turn-based strategy game inspired by events and stories of forgotten and unsung heroes of WW2. Unique and new-to-genre features offer immersion and deeper protagonists to lead and care for. Lead the resistance against the Axis Forces.

Name: Among Trees
ShortDescription: Escape to an enchanting, living sandbox surrounded by wildlife and nature. Scavenge materials and craft tools to turn your small cabin into a warm, well-supplied home. Survive by fishing, cooking and growing your own food. Be careful though, the forest is as dangerous as it is wonderful.

Name: Unknown 9: Awakening
ShortDescription: Tu és Haroona, uma Quaestor nascida com a capacidade de se aventurar numa dimensão misteriosa: o Fold. Na sua demanda por conhecimentos ocultos, ela aprenderá a dominar os poderes do Fold para enfrentar uma sociedade secreta com uma agenda hostil.

Name: Game Builder Tycoon
ShortDescription: Em Game Builder Tycoon, começa como um desenvolvedor de jogos indie. Personaliza o teu personagem, cria jogos de sucesso, gere marketing, investiga e gere uma equipa qualificada.

Name: Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered
ShortDescription: Em Marvel's Spider-Man Remasterizado, os mundos do Peter Parker e do Spider-Man colidem numa história repleta de ação. Encontra um Peter Parker experiente e combate o crime e os vilões icónicos da Nova Iorque da Marvel. Baloiça por bairros vibrantes e vence vilões com neutralizações épicas.

Name: Ziggurat 2
ShortDescription: Ziggurat is back, and now it's even better! Use powerful weapons and spells to break through hordes of enemies and explore labyrinthine dungeons in this hectic roguelite FPS, while you improve your skills and discover new equipment.

Name: Papa’s Pizzeria Deluxe
ShortDescription: Top, bake, and serve delicious pizzas in Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe! Craft pizzas for Papa Louie's loyal customers while earning tips, points, and Special Recipes. Unlock holiday ingredients for seasonal pies, and take a trip in the Food Truck to serve your own unique creations!

Name: ZERO Sievert
ShortDescription: Now with over 500,000 copies sold, ZERO Sievert is a tense top-down extraction shooter that challenges you to scavenge a procedurally-generated wasteland, loot gear, and explore what’s left of a devastated world. When the odds are stacked against you, you’ll need to do more than just survive...

Name: Amanda the Adventurer 2
ShortDescription: Join Amanda and her pal Wooly on a series of adventures as they explore and learn about our wonderful world! With several NEW play-along, laugh-along, learn-along episodes there's always fun to be had! Just make sure to do everything Amanda says or she might get angry.

Name: Kerbal Space Program 2
ShortDescription: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics.

Name: Loco Motive
ShortDescription: There's been a murder aboard the Reuss Express, and you're the suspects! Prove your innocence in this comedy 'point n' click' murder mystery - packed with twists, laughs, and larger-than-life characters!

Name: Servonauts
ShortDescription: Um jogo de construção de postos de combustível em coop para 1 a 4 jogadores! Administre um "servo" (posto de combustível na Austrália) enquanto atende viajantes espaciais impacientes. Domine tubos, instale refinarias e misture os combustíveis certos para otimizar seus postos espaciais.

Name: Speed Lane
ShortDescription: Este é um jogo de corrida dinâmico com pistas geradas proceduralmente. Desvie do tráfego, colete bônus e melhore seu carro para conquistar todas as rotas em qualquer condição climática. Escolha entre 10 carros realistas e quebre novos recordes de velocidade!

Name: SCP: Descent
ShortDescription: Inspired by SCP-087, step into the shoes of an unfortunate student long before the stairwell became legend. Follow the clues left by those who came before, your only choice is to descend.

Name: MechWarrior 5: Clans
ShortDescription: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs and explore strategic options.

Name: Void Crew
ShortDescription: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 6 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

Name: Mutilate-a-Doll 2
ShortDescription: A highly customizable virtual stressball and physics sandbox about mutilating ragdolls in various ways using an overwhelming amount of weapons and tools.

Name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
ShortDescription: Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

Name: Tortuga – A Pirates Tale
ShortDescription: Tortuga - A Pirate's Tale conta a aventura, entre tesouros e glória, de um capitão pirata que assume o comando de uma frota de navios rumo ao domínio das Caraíbas.

Name: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes
ShortDescription: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes is a first-person psychological horror adventure game. Explore your dark family history, solve puzzles and experience a gut-wrenching feeling of terror. You are being watched; never alone, never safe.

Name: Hello Neighbor 2
ShortDescription: Welcome back to the eerie town of Raven Brooks! You play as Quentin, a journalist investigating the bizarre events of the original Hello Neighbor game, uncovering a larger mystery. Sneak into your creepy Neighbors’ houses to dig up the truth.

Name: CROWDED. FOLLOWED.
ShortDescription: You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else. A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.

Name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII STEAM EDITION
ShortDescription: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV finally hits STEAM! KOF XIV is back with its classic 2D gameplay and "3-on-3 TEAM BATTLE" game system but evolved to 3D! 58 charismatic fighters are about to clash in this new chapter of KOF!

Name: Superdimension Neptune VS Sega Hard Girls
ShortDescription: A collaboration project between ASCII Media Works’ Dengeki Bunko and SEGA, the Sega Hard Girls are made up of various Sega consoles, including the Dreamcast, Sega Saturn, and Mega Drive! These anthropomorphized consoles are girls with an array of personalities and spunk, and this time they are teaming up with Neptune and IF for an...

Name: Critter Café
ShortDescription: Damos-te as boas-vindas ao Critter Café! Salva adoráveis criaturas fantásticas, cria laços com elas e constrói-lhes um novo lar com a sua ajuda. Desenha e gere o teu café, cuida das tuas criaturas, revela os segredos dos misteriosos portais e cria um café acolhedor para todos!

Name: Été
ShortDescription: Été (verão) é um jogo de pintura relaxante que se passa em Montreal. Enche a cidade de cor, explora, pinta telas com obras de arte, cola selos no teu álbum, decora o teu estúdio, aceita encomendas dos teus vizinhos e solta o artista que há em ti!

Name: Windblown
ShortDescription: Dash, dive and defy the Vortex. A lightning-fast, 1-3 player co-op roguelite from the crafters of Dead Cells, where every run is a leap into chaos. Absorb the powers of fallen warriors, rebuild their weapons, and WIPE THE FLOOR with anything that gets in the way of a perfect run.

Name: MXGP 24: The Official Game
ShortDescription: Após um hiato de 3 anos, o jogo oficial do MXGP está de volta. Vive todo o campeonato de 2024 com as suas 20 pistas oficiais e mais de 50 pilotos das categorias MX1/MX2. Sente a imersão do MXGP num modo carreira completo e aprofundado.

Name: Snow Bros. Wonderland
ShortDescription: O inverno está a chegar. Snow Bros. está de volta na nova aventura da Tatsujin!

Name: Grounded
ShortDescription: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

Name: Aunt Fatima
ShortDescription: Aunt Fatima's House: Solve puzzles, find items, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Fatima in this scary horror game.Can you escape the deadly house?

Name: Megadimension Neptunia VII
ShortDescription: New challengers are taking control of Gamindustri, and Neptune's nowhere in sight. Now she’s gotta help a mysterious stranger fight a colossal new evil, reclaim her Goddess title, and find some time for pudding! Go next gen with Giant Battles and multi-worlds in this JRPG!

Name: The Baby In Yellow
ShortDescription: Tens um novo trabalho que é cuidar de bebés e as coisas estão a dar para o torto. Dá-lhe de comer, lê-lhe uma história para dormir e tenta não cair nos seus sonhos. Durante quanto tempo consegues manter o controlo?

Name: Bugsnax
ShortDescription: Apanha misteriosos snacks vivos e empanturra os teus amigos nesta incomum aventura insular!

Name: W.A.N.D Project
ShortDescription: Mergulhe em um implacável roguelike de bullet hell, onde sobreviver significa personalizar seus feitiços na hora. Enfrente ondas monstruosas para salvar Tóquio. Escolha sua feiticeira e ajuste sua magia para derrotar os demônios.

Name: Yakuza 6: The Song of Life
ShortDescription: Até onde irias pela tua família? Entra no submundo do crime japonês de punhos erguidos neste jogo de ação explosivo protagonizado pelo lendário membro da yakuza Kazuma Kiryu, que está determinado a desvendar a verdade por trás de um trágico acidente que deixou a sua filha em coma.

Name: Police Stories
ShortDescription: A fresh take on top-down shooters with an emphasis on tactics that forces you to make split second decisions. Neutralize criminals, rescue civilians and defuse bombs in Single Player mode or Co-op. And remember - shooting first is not an option!

Name: Roboquest
ShortDescription: Roboquest is a fast FPS Roguelite in a scorched futureworld. You're a rebooted Guardian, ready to kick some metal ass! Fight with your buddy or by yourself and annihilate hordes of deadly bots in ever-changing environments.

Name: Cat Quest III
ShortDescription: Em Cat Quest III, assumes o papel de um gatorsário num mundo aberto em 2,5D de exploração livre, repleto de pirratos. Desfralda as velas e navega os mares em busca de grandes tesouros! Mas prepara-te para o perigo, pois o Rei Pirata quer caçar-te…

Name: Peace, Death! 2
ShortDescription: Peace, Death! 2 is a midcore turn-based logic game where you send clients to Hell, Heaven, or Purgatory and help members of the Reapers Union as they work towards their great cause!

Name: Get To Work
ShortDescription: You are poor and bald. Get to Work.

Name: Outta Hand
ShortDescription: Outta Hand lets you embody one of the Hand-People, wide-eyed, hop-happy lab experiments with the power to jump great heights, leap impossible lengths, and shake hands from… really, really far away. Like a whole big dining room away.

Name: AVIÃOZINHO DO TRÁFICO 3:ABRI UM PORTAL PRO INFERNO NA FAVELA TENTANDO REVIVER MIT AIA E PRECISO FECHAR
ShortDescription: A BRAZILIAN BOOMER SHOOTER GAME MADE USING THE ID TECH 2 ENGINE! SHOOT, JUMP, EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGHOUT THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE BRAZIL!

Name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
ShortDescription: Descobre como pensam as pessoas por todo o mundo! The Jackbox Survey Scramble é uma coleção de jogos de festa hilariantes com base em inquéritos, utilizando respostas reais de uma palavra, de pessoas reais. A sério! Pega em alguns amigos e começa a adivinhar!

Name: Potion Permit
ShortDescription: Os habitantes de Moonbury precisam de curativos e tu és o melhor químico disponível! Com as tuas ferramentas de confiança, um caldeirão e um companheiro canino, terás de diagnosticar sintomas, recolher ingredientes, preparar poções e curar doenças nesta simulação RPG cheia de possibilidades.

Name: Project Wingman
ShortDescription: Project Wingman is a flight action game that lets you take the seat of advanced fighter jets and become a true ace. Fight in various missions and gamemodes ranging from intense aerial dogfights to large scale ground assault in an alternate scorched earth setting.

Name: Battle Shapers
ShortDescription: Battle Shapers is an action-packed, sci-fi FPS roguelite in which you shoot and smash your way through swarms of corrupt robots. Wield powerful weapons, abilities, and game-changing new powers stolen from ruthless Overlords.

Name: Sons Of The Forest
ShortDescription: Sent to find a missing billionaire on a remote island, you find yourself in a cannibal-infested hellscape. Craft, build, and struggle to survive, alone or with friends, in this terrifying new open-world survival horror simulator.

Name: Amazing Frog?
ShortDescription: Amazing Frog? is an openworld, sandbox, physics game. Grand Frog Auto in Swindon, with farting ragdoll frogs.

Name: Blazing Sails
ShortDescription: Sobrevive no Blazing Sails, um jogo de piratas JvJ frenético! Cria o teu próprio pirata e navio. Junta-te a outros jogadores e comanda a tua poderosa embarcação. Explora diferentes modos de jogo, mapas, armas, navios e muito mais, enquanto derrotas tripulações em batalhas épicas na terra e mar.

Name: Dome Keeper
ShortDescription: Enfrenta montes de monstros alienígenas neste roguelite de ação e exploração mineira único. Procura recursos, encontra engenhocas e melhora equipamentos para sobreviveres... mas despacha-te ou a tua cúpula é destruída!

Name: Potionomics
ShortDescription: You’ve inherited your uncle’s potion shop—and a huge debt. Better get brewing! Customize your store, hire heroes to gather ingredients, befriend (or romance) fellow vendors to learn new haggling strategies, and go head-to-head with competitors in this narrative-driven, deck-building shop simulator.

Name: The Thing: Remastered
ShortDescription: The Thing: Remastered é uma restauração fiel do clássico cult de 2002 jogo de tiro de terror de sobrevivência em terceira pessoa inspirado no filme de 1982 da Universal Pictures, The Thing

Name: Until Dawn
ShortDescription: Reconstruído e melhorado para o PC, Until Dawn convida-te a regressar ao pesadelo e a envolveres-te numa história de horror cativante onde todas as decisões podem fazer a diferença entre a vida e a morte.

Name: Finnish Cottage Simulator
ShortDescription: Finnish Cottage Simulator is the ultimate cottage experience. Relax and enjoy the Finnish summer nature, go to the sauna, get drunk, grill food or play games with others!

Name: Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story
ShortDescription: A simulation game where you create a wonderful sweets shop with Doraemon

Name: Children of the Sun
ShortDescription: Espera-te uma aventura de mundo aberto de cortar a respiração! Explora reinos mágicos, restaura a luz perdida e cria laços sem palavras com jogadores de todo o mundo. Completa missões e resolve puzzles em eventos sazonais que celebram a bondade, a descoberta e as ligações sentidas.

Name: ELDERBORN
ShortDescription: ELDERBORN - a Metal AF* Slasher with brutal FPP melee combat and souls-like/RPG character progression. In the times of legend, barbarian tribes need a new dark messiah. Be that merciless slayer. Uncover ancient secrets in the city of doom. Forge your own destiny! *Action Fantasy.

Name: Nuclear Nightmare
ShortDescription: Venture forth as part of a specialized team of fellow players tasked with retrieving classified materials, evading the black goo virus, and the nightmarish entities it has spawned. With time running out before the US government initiates a devastating nuclear strike to contain the spreading menace.

Name: Sengoku Dynasty
ShortDescription: Sengoku Dynasty is the ultimate feudal Japan experience: build villages, grow your community, and shape the open world through combat or economy. The choice is yours alone - or that of up to 4 players in multiplayer co-op!

Name: HoloCure - Save the Fans!
ShortDescription: Play as your favorite Vtubers from Hololive! Fight, explore, and clear your way through armies of fans and save them from their mind-control in this unofficial free fan-game.

Name: Deck of Souls
ShortDescription: Roguelite deck-building meets souls-like. Break out of an infinite loop to close the hell gates, turn enemies into cards, and build your own omnipotent Deck of Souls! Rolls included.

Name: Astrometica
ShortDescription: Astrometica is a space exploration and base-building survival game. After a catastrophic event, explore vast space, gather resources, build bases, and uncover cosmic mysteries. Use advanced technology, craft tools, and discover new blueprints to survive and thrive in the unknown.

Name: Kynseed
ShortDescription: Embark on a lifetime of adventure in a beautiful world of creativity and intrigue. Raise a family, customise your farm, run a business, craft items, and battle some marvellously malevolent monsters.

Name: Never Alone (Kisima Ingitchuna)
ShortDescription: Experience the epic journey of Nuna and Fox as they search for the source of an eternal blizzard that threatens the survival of everything they have ever known.

Name: Creeper World IXE
ShortDescription: The unstoppable alien force known as The Creeper has returned, devouring thousands of worlds in its path, and yours is next. Battle against the Creeper fluid in a groundbreaking pixel-level simulation to prove that humanity will rule the galaxy forever!

Name: Granny: Escape Together
ShortDescription: This is a creepy co-op horror game. In which you find yourself locked in a crazy Granny's house. But Granny is not the only danger that awaits you in the house, someone else creepy lives in the basement. You have five days to get out of the house!

Name: Ballionaire
ShortDescription: BALLIONAIRE é um frenético roguelike cinético, onde a estratégia e a física se aliam para criarem uma riqueza verdadeiramente surpreendente! Descobre e explora sinergias inovadoras enquanto analisas as tuas possibilidades de alcançares a vitória! Desfruta deste género autobonker!

Name: WEBFISHING
ShortDescription: WEBFISHING a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

Name: Sifu
ShortDescription: Sifu é um jogo de luta realista na terceira pessoa com mecânicas de combate de Kung Fu e ação cinematográfica de artes marciais que te leva por um caminho de vingança.

Name: ICARUS
ShortDescription: ICARUS is a solo or multiplayer PvE survival game. Explore a savage wilderness in the aftermath of terraforming gone wrong. Complete narrative quests as either Open World operations or Individual Missions. Explore, build, craft and hunt while seeking your fortune and prospecting for exotic matter.

Name: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition
ShortDescription: The classic adventure returns! Baldur’s Gate: Enhanced Edition includes the original Baldur’s Gate adventure, the Tales of the Sword Coast expansion, and all-new content including three new party members.

Name: Hell Yeah! Wrath of the Dead Rabbit
ShortDescription: A crazy action-adventure platformer... In Hell.

Name: The Cabin Factory
ShortDescription: Your job at the Cabin Factory is simple: inspect the cabins and decide on whether they’re haunted or not. If you do find any anomalies, get out…immediately.

Name: Heat Death Survival Train
ShortDescription: Heat Death is a sci-fi survival game where you can build, upgrade, and customize your battle train to explore and survive a frozen world! This train is not only your shelter and vehicle, but also your weapon and ally to face hostile drones, deadly storms, and hidden mysteries of an unknown world!

Name: NAIAD
ShortDescription: Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist and colorful adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. Enjoy a wholesome experience with an original and dreamy visual style.

Name: Emergency 2012
ShortDescription: The year is 2012 and the world as we know it seems to have spiraled out of control. As the head of rescue operations it’s your job to ensure the safety of the population.

Name: Northgard
ShortDescription: Northgard: Definitive Edition is a critically acclaimed real-time strategy game based on Norse mythology. Lead your clan, uncover the secrets of a mysterious newfound continent and defeat your enemies to conquer the Throne!

Name: Farmers Life
ShortDescription: 🌾Liberte o Fazendeiro que existe dentro de você. 🚜 Mergulhe no encanto rústico da vida rural em "Farmer's Life", onde você experimentará a alegria e os desafios da vida em uma fazenda vibrante. Plante, cresça e abrace um país que vive em um vasto mundo aberto.

Name: Idle Colony
ShortDescription: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

Name: OneShot: World Machine Edition
ShortDescription: A completely self-contained portable version of one of the highest user-rated games. Built on an entirely new engine with new UI, support for Steam Deck, & more. Features world-bending puzzles, intriguing denizens, surreal environments, and a captivating story about the truth of the game's reality.

Name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY
ShortDescription: Joga como a Nova Criança em South Park e junta-te a Cartman, Stan, Kyle e Kenny em três gloriosas dimensões para celebrar um dia mágico na vida de qualquer criança: um dia de neve!

Name: South Park: The Stick of Truth
ShortDescription: From the perilous battlefields of the fourth-grade playground, a young hero will rise, destined to be South Park’s savior. From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes an epic quest to become… cool. Introducing South Park™: The Stick of Truth™.For a thousand years, the battle has been waged.

Name: Menace from the Deep
ShortDescription: Menace from the Deep is an enthralling Roguelike Deckbuilding card game that unfolds in a dark world, drawing inspiration from Howard Lovecraft and the Cthulhu Mythos.Set against the backdrop of 1920s USA, the narrative revolves around a clandestine occult society.

Name: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
ShortDescription: Crianças também podem mudar o mundo. Junte-se a Alba em uma aventura para salvar sua linda ilha e os bichos que moram lá. E quem sabe até começar uma revolução.

Name: Sheltered
ShortDescription: Neste brutal simulador de gestão de sobreviventes passado num mundo pós-apocalíptico, tens de manter viva a tua fação de sobreviventes, fazer a manutenção do teu abrigo e explorar o mundo devastado para obter recursos. Cria laços comerciais e de amizade com outras fações ou conquista-as pela força.

Name: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
ShortDescription: Hidden Cats in Tokyo is a hidden object adventure game where you must vaccinate all the cats in Tokyo before they turn into dangerous monsters. Collect cards of heroes, monsters, and cat things. Join the adventure and fight the huge monster with your giant robot in this fun hidden object game!

Name: APICO
ShortDescription: APICO is a laid-back beekeeping sim game about breeding, collecting, & conserving bees! Set in a series of lush environments, APICO uniquely combines resource gathering, biology, and beekeeping minigames, taking ideas from a mix of real-life and fantasy apiculture & floriculture.

Name: Moonstone Island
ShortDescription: Moonstone Island é um simulador de vida onde terás de colecionar criaturas num mundo aberto com 100 ilhas para explorar. Faz amizades, cria poções, coleciona Espíritos e testa a tua força em encontros com cartas para concluir o teu treino de Alquimia!

Name: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator
ShortDescription: Lidere os molengas vermelhos e azuis de terras antigas, lugares assustadores e mundos fantásticos. Veja-os lutar em simulações feitas com o sistema de física mais molenga já criado.

Name: HROT
ShortDescription: HROT is a single-player retro FPS set in a small socialist country neighboring Soviet Union (Czechoslovakia) after an unspecified disaster in 1986. Those times were dark and terrifying and so is the game.

Name: Progressbar95
ShortDescription: Progressbar95 é um jogo hiper-casual nostálgico único. Ele fará você sorrir.

Name: Beastieball
ShortDescription: A turn-based volleyball RPG where you coach a sports team of Beasties! Your Beasties' relationships grow and change, unlocking new abilities and combo plays!

Name: Airships: Conquer the Skies
ShortDescription: Construct mighty steampunk airships and fly them into battle, waging war and conquering the skies!

Name: Pawperty Damage
ShortDescription: Smash, kick, stomp and chomp your way through a fully destructible city! Go to town in this cathartic action sandbox, either alone or in split screen local multiplayer.

Name: Catherine Classic
ShortDescription: Catherine: a tale of love, betrayal, and the terror of commitment. Experience the mature action-adventure-puzzle game unlike any other from the makers of the Persona series, now enhanced for PC in all its Classic glory. Is love over? Climb to the top or die trying.

Name: Mullet Madjack
ShortDescription: MULLET MAD JACK é um FPS super rápido para um jogador onde você está dentro de um ANIME CLÁSSICO. Fortaleça seu personagem até chegar ao último andar. Faça o seu melhor tempo ou tente novamente.

Name: Orcs Must Die!
ShortDescription: Corta-os, queima-os, espeta-os e lança-os - não interessa como o fazes, os orcs têm que morrer neste fantástico jogo de ação/estratégia da Robot Entertainment.

Name: METALLIC CHILD
ShortDescription: “Grab, hurl, and eliminate” Rogue-lite Core-Action!! A large-scale rebellion erupts within the spacecraft “Life Stream.” With the help of you, Rona, an android known as “Metallic Child,” stands up against a fleet of massive robots to stop the plot devised by her own creator, Doctor Irene.

Name: Sheltered 2
ShortDescription: Neste brutal simulador de gestão de sobreviventes passado num mundo pós-apocalíptico, tens de manter viva a tua fação de sobreviventes, fazer a manutenção do teu abrigo e explorar o mundo devastado para obter recursos. Cria laços comerciais e de amizade com outras fações ou conquista-as pela força.

Name: KitHack Model Club
ShortDescription: Developed by the creator of the original Kerbal Space Program, KitHack Model Club is a physics-based model building sandbox that offers limitless freedom for you and your friends. Design, build, battle, fly (and crash!) your very own RC vehicles, or experiment with over 2,400 ready-made vehicles!

Name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
ShortDescription: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead é um jogo de terror e aventura para um único jogador, inspirado no blockbuster aclamado pela crítica. Sobrevive em silêncio.

Name: Okami HD
ShortDescription: Fica a conhecer esta prestigiada obra-prima, e vê como os seus notáveis visuais pintados em estilo Sumi-e ganham nova vida numa alta resolução arrebatadora.

Name: FINAL FANTASY V: Pixel Remaster
ShortDescription: The mega-hit RPG, FINAL FANTASY VIII returns! This Steam® version features new graphical enhancements and a whole host of options to customise your gameplay experience.

Name: Citadelum
ShortDescription: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.

Name: Coromon
ShortDescription: Coromon é uma versão moderna do género clássico de domar monstros. Domina Coromon e explora um vasto mundo cheio de emocionantes batalhas, puzzles que te fazem revirar o cérebro e uma misteriosa ameaça ao mundo à espera de ser derrotada. Não vai ser fácil!

Name: Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse
ShortDescription: O RPG de sobrevivência em mundo aberto "Bad 2 Bad: Apocalypse" conta a história da Equipa Delta e dos seus camaradas, enquanto trabalham para reconstruir um mundo devastado pelos humanos e a sua raça transformada em zombies.

Name: DigDigDrill
ShortDescription: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

Name: Chicken Invaders
ShortDescription: A deliciously addictive core of finger-blistering shooting action, surrounded by delectable morsels of galactic exploration, spacecraft customization, and community competitions.

Name: Uncle Chops Rocket Shop
ShortDescription: Come on down to Uncle Chop’s Rocket Shop, for all your roguelite spaceship repair simulation needs! WARNING: Untested genre not suitable for people with tentacles for arms or an aversion to dying horrifically. Side effects include improved reading comprehension under pressure and a furry fetish.

Name: Goat Simulator 3
ShortDescription: Pilgor está de volta! Junte o rebanho e mergulhe em Goat Simulator 3: uma experiência rural inédita (no Steam, pelo menos) e realista em um mundo aberto. Convide até três pessoas no modo cooperativo local ou online para destruir tudo como um time ou competir nos minijogos, e perder as amizades.

Name: SimAirport
ShortDescription: Build & Manage Your Airport. An International Hub or a Regional Masterpiece -- it's up to you. Buy more land to scale out, or escalators to scale up with MULTIPLE FLOORS. You're in full control in this modern business management tycoon!

Name: REYNATIS
ShortDescription: Fantasy meets reality in Shibuya, Tokyo, where magic is something to be feared. In this action RPG, a young wizard seeks freedom through strength, and an officer seeks to control magic and restore order. When their paths cross, a darkness that will transform the world descends.

Name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure
ShortDescription: The Special Support Section is back with more members and more cases to solve! How will this rag-tag group deal with the oncoming threats to Crossbell’s political stability while maintaining their team’s foundation?

Name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
ShortDescription: When Lloyd Bannings is assigned to Crossbell's Special Support Section, he and his new teammates must prove themselves as they fight to overcome the injustice of a city gripped by corruption.

Name: Oxenfree
ShortDescription: Five years after the events of OXENFREE, Riley returns to her hometown of Camena to investigate mysterious radio signals. What she finds is more than she bargained for.

Name: Hob
ShortDescription: Transforme o mundo de Hob! O novo jogo de ação e aventura da Runic Games, o premiado estúdio criador de Torchlight I e II. Esta é sua chance. Vá até o fim.

Name: Medieval Blacksmith
ShortDescription: Forje seu destino. Crie lendas. Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith é sua jornada à essência da criação. Entre em um mundo encantado de ferraria, obtenha minérios preciosos e domine a forja. Crie armas lendárias e complemente-as com magia em um mundo de fantasia vibrante!

Name: Shotgun King: The Final Checkmate
ShortDescription: Chess, but you replace your entire army with a royal shotgun. A unique strategy roguelike based on the timeless checkboard classic.

Name: Recettear: An Item Shops Tale
ShortDescription: Recettear is the story of an item shop, the girl who lives in it, and the fairy who turned her life upside down. Recette Lemongrass finds herself in charge of an item shop built into her house, in order to pay back a loan her father took and then skipped out on - and Tear, her newfound fairy "companion", won't take no for an answer!

Name: Coreupt
ShortDescription: Black Salt Coreuption is a one-on-one 3D arena fighting game that allows complete freedom of movement around the arena rather than 3D fighters doing combat on a 2D plane. The Black Salt Coreuption 3D arena fighting game series also combines two action properties. (Black Salt Vs COREUPT)

Name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash
ShortDescription: As Umamusume desenhadas em pixel participam no evento especial de primavera "Hachamecha Grand Prix" como agradecimento aos incríveis fãs. Que equipa vencerá as quatro competições e se tornará campeã!?

Name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
ShortDescription: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

Name: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip
ShortDescription: Embark on a road trip like no other in this co-op narrative survival adventure. Visit fun locations, meet wacky characters, and manage your resources wisely. And yes: you still can date some hot monsters ;)

Name: Hooked on You: A Dead by Daylight Dating Sim
ShortDescription: Welcome to Murderer’s Island. Your companions: four dead-sexy Killers who, underneath their murderous exteriors, just want a little romance. Flirt your way into their hearts, uncovering dark twists along the way. Will you find true love, forge friendships… or get hacked to death?

Name: Esports History
ShortDescription: Esports History é um simulador RPG onde você inicia como um rapaz comum e trabalha até chegar ao topo dos esports. Derrote chefes nos torneios, crie o seu nome dentro da comunidade dos esports e torne-se um verdadeiro profissional!

Name: Detention
ShortDescription: Detention is an atmospheric horror game set in 1960s Taiwan under martial law. Incorporated religious elements based in Taiwanese/Chinese culture and mythology, the game provided players with unique graphics and gaming experience.

Name: Marvel’s Spider-Man: Miles Morales
ShortDescription: Depois de Marvel's Spider-Man Remasterizado, o Miles Morales adapta-se ao seu novo lar enquanto segue as pisadas do seu mentor, o Peter Parker, para se tornar o novo Spider-Man. Quando uma disputa pelo poder ameaça destruir o seu lar, o Miles tem de entrar em ação e assumir o papel de Spider-Man.

Name: Chicken Feet
ShortDescription: Chicken Feet is a first person survival-stealth horror game about a giant, angry chicken. Descend into the depths of GOOBER laboratories and uncover the horrors that lie beneath the lab's shiny façade.

Name: Mad Max
ShortDescription: Joga como Mad Max, um herói relutante e um sobrevivente, Max não quer nada mais do que deixar a loucura para trás e encontrar um pouco de paz.

Name: Steep
ShortDescription: Percorra o mundo aberto dos Alpes, onde a neve é sempre fresca e a adrenalina nunca acaba. Desafie e domine a montanha sozinho ou com amigos em skis, wingsuits, snowboards e parapentes. Grave e compartilhe suas proezas.

Name: Fireworks Mania – An Explosive Simulator
ShortDescription: FIREWORKS MANIA é um pequeno jogo casual de simulador de explosivos onde você brinca com fogos de artifício, cria belos shows de fogos de artifício ou simplesmente explode tudo que ver pela frente.

Name: Home Safety Hotline
ShortDescription: Hearing noises? Seeing things? Call Home Safety Hotline! Our operators are standing by, waiting to give you the answers you need to protect your home from all manner of pests and household hazards.

Name: Baldi’s Basics Plus
ShortDescription: Baldi's Basics® Plus is an active stealth roguelike that parodies cheap '90s edutainment with a subtle horror twist! Play Hide & Seek with Baldi as he chases you through procedurally generated levels while using your surroundings, items, and game knowledge to shift chaos in your favor.

Name: Angels of Death
ShortDescription: "Please... kill me." "Help me get outta here, and I'll kill you." ~ Angels of Death is a psychological horror-adventure game, consisting of four episodes.

Name: Wardens Will
ShortDescription: Warden's Will é um jogo de tiros de movimento em terceira pessoa com mecânicas de combate bullet hell e roguelite, jogado a solo ou em modo cooperativo de até 3 jogadores. Escolhe entre uma grande variedade Wardens, armas e aumentos para criares configurações únicas e destruíres robôs maquiavélicos.

Name: The Long Drive
ShortDescription: Random generated open world semi-post apocalyptic survival car driving game.

Name: Empires of the Undergrowth
ShortDescription: Command swarms of warriors at an unprecedented scale of warfare in this blend of RTS and base-building. Lead ant colonies against the many fearsome threats of the insect world, while building intricate nests, developing pheromone-based tactics, and evolving to meet growing dangers.

Name: The Rangers In The South
ShortDescription: Purifique as terras neste ARPG Pixelart RogueLike 2.5D! Crie centenas de personagens com estratégias e habilidades únicas, enfrente hordas de inimigos, explore diferentes biomas, masmorras geradas proceduralmente e obtenha itens únicos!

Name: Joyville 2
ShortDescription: Joyville 2 is a first-person horror puzzle-adventure game set in an abandoned children's camp. Explore two parallel worlds where the joy of the past meets present horrors. Uncover the camp's dark secrets, face magical yet dangerous creatures, and discover the truth behind events from decades ago.

Name: The Inn-Sanity
ShortDescription: Early 90s. You stayed in a quiet hotel for just one night and the next morning you’ve found out that the old world was destroyed. Alien dreams, secrets of your past and other guests that are turning into monsters. This hotel will not let you to check out.

Name: Left 4 Dead
ShortDescription: Set in the zombie apocalypse, Left 4 Dead 2 is a co-operative action horror FPS takes you and your friends through the cities, swamps and cemeteries of the Deep South, from Savannah to New Orleans across five expansive campaigns.

Name: rFactor 2
ShortDescription: rFactor 2 is a realistic, easily extendable racing simulation that offers race customization, great graphics, outstanding multiplayer and the height of racing realism. It features mixed class road racing with ultra realistic dynamics, an immersive sound environment and stunning graphics.

Name: Magicbook AutoBattler
ShortDescription: Este é um novo jogo de xadrez automático estratégico que integra elementos de RPG e roguelike. No mundo do Grimório, os jogadores podem criar combinações livremente e entrar em batalhas intermináveis.

Name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
ShortDescription: Embarque rumo à Grécia Antiga neste jogo de ação e aventura para alterar o destino da civilização. Trave batalhas intensas em terra e mar, molde seu destino de exilado a lenda e desvende os segredos do seu passado.

Name: Stay Out of the House
ShortDescription: Can you escape the home of a cannibal serial killer? It's only a matter of time until you're dinner!

Name: Airborne Empire
ShortDescription: Build your sky city while exploring a vast landscape in this Open World RPG City Builder. Combining the methodical construction and management of a city builder; the unique lift, balance, and propulsion needed for a flying city; and the compelling characters, dangers, and adventures of an RPG!

Name: BLADECHIMERA
ShortDescription: Explore a dark and sinister Osaka as the Demon Hunter Shin. Battle demons, regain lost skills, and uncover the truth of your forgotten past in this exciting occult-inspired cyberpunk metroidvania.

Name: Luck be a Landlord
ShortDescription: Luck be a Landlord é um roguelike de deckbuilding, em que tens que usar uma slot machine para ganhar dinheiro para a renda e derrotar o capitalismo. Este jogo não usa moedas de verdade para apostas nem microtransações.

Name: Sand:box
ShortDescription: Pixel Worlds is a free-to-play sandbox MMO where players build worlds, craft items, explore dungeons, farm resources, and trade in a player-driven economy, all within a shared online universe rebuilt as a fresh start for a fair and stable long-term experience.

Name: Love is All Around
ShortDescription: The player becomes Gu Yi, uses the first-person perspective to immerse himself in meeting six beauties, and embarks on a joyful and sweet love journey with them. Six girls that are charming, innocent, intelligent, wild, sexy, glamorous, who will go to the end with you is up to you to decide.

Name: Settlements Rising
ShortDescription: Settlements Rising is a medieval city building and colony management game. It offers a lively colony experience with simulated villagers, dozens of professions and resources, natural disasters, and raids, while providing full control over the colony through trade, production chains and datas.

Name: WWE 2K23
ShortDescription: WWE 2K23 está ainda mais forte com características expandidas, gráficos deslumbrantes e uma lista avançada de Superestrelas e Lendas da WWE. 2K Showcase regressa como um documentário desportivo interativo focado nos 20 anos de carreira de John Cena, e WarGames chegou finalmente!

Name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
ShortDescription: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

Name: DISORDER
ShortDescription: DISORDER is a dark, twisted word puzzle horror game where your mistakes hold irreversible consequences. Players will be challenged to play through a series of challenging rounds in an attempt to 'Save Your Family' if the player fails a round they then 'Choose Who Dies'

Name: Make Way
ShortDescription: Acelera em loopings, fecha os olhos quando atravessares caminhos-de-ferro, dá prego a fundo entre obstáculos e usa armas extravagantes. Neste jogo clássico de corridas és tu quem constrói a pista!

Name: STAR WARS: Episode I: Jedi Power Battles
ShortDescription: Reconquista o Palácio Real de Theed neste jogo de ação rápido e furioso com sabres de luz. Terás o poder da Força e o teu leal Sabre de Luz para afugentar legiões de droides de batalha e de destruição, assassinos e outras criaturas de Star Wars: Episódio I – A Ameaça Fantasma.

Name: The Case of the Golden Idol
ShortDescription: A new kind of detective game that allows you to think and investigate freely. Discover clues surrounding 12 strange and gruesome deaths and build your own theory. Pick your suspect, deduce the motive, unmask the awful truth.

Name: Endoparasitic
ShortDescription: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must save your research. Drag yourself through the corridors of a secret research lab on a remote asteroid, fight off horribly mutated monsters, inject countless syringes of vaccines, and survive at all costs.

Name: Overcooked
ShortDescription: Overcooked é um jogo de culinária cooperativo de sofá para 1 a 4 jogadores. Em equipa, tu e os teus colegas chefes de cozinha têm de preparar, cozinhar e servir deliciosos pedidos antes que os clientes reclamadores saiam irritados.

Name: Overcooked 2
ShortDescription: Overcooked regressa com uma nova dose de caótica ação culinária! Volta ao Reino das Cebolas e cria a tua equipa de chefes para entrar em partidas cooperativas locais ou online para até quatro jogadores. Aperta bem o avental... chegou a hora de salvar o mundo (de novo!)

Name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
ShortDescription: És Geralt of Rivia, um mercenário caçador de monstros. Perante ti, encontras um continente destruído e infestado por monstros, que podes explorar como quiseres. O teu contrato: encontrar Ciri, a Criança da Profecia, uma arma viva capaz de alterar a forma do mundo.

Name: Little Nightmares
ShortDescription: Explora Little Nightmares, um conto peculiar e macabro no qual irás enfrentar os teus medos de infância! Ajuda a Six a fugir da Bocarra, uma enorme e misteriosa criatura habitada por almas corrompidas em busca da sua próxima refeição…

Name: Celeste
ShortDescription: Ajuda Madeline a sobreviver aos seus demónios interiores na jornada até ao topo da Montanha Celeste neste jogo de plataformas dos criadores de TowerFall. Enfrenta centenas de desafios, desvenda segredos perturbadores e revela o mistério da montanha.

Name: TEKKEN 7
ShortDescription: Descobre a conclusão épica da prolongada guerra entre os membros da família Mishima. Com o poder do Unreal Engine 4, esta lendária série de jogos de luta regressa com espantosas batalhas cinemáticas e duelos intensos que podes partilhar com amigos e rivais.

Name: Persona 5 Strikers
ShortDescription: Join the Phantom Thieves and strike back against the corruption overtaking cities across Japan. A summer vacation with close friends takes a sudden turn as a distorted reality emerges; reveal the truth and redeem the hearts of those imprisoned at the center of the crisis!

Name: Indies Lies
ShortDescription: A roguelike deck-building game where you craft a deck, spark talents, discover runes, and assemble your team with partners' cards! Play unique stories for every character and explore a world caught in the clash of gods. New Puppeteer DLC just released!

Name: Mika and The Witch's Mountain
ShortDescription: Mika and the Witch’s Mountain é uma aventura de fantasia sobre uma aspirante a bruxa que entrega pacotes aos habitantes de uma pequena ilha. Explore cada recanto e voe pelo céu com sua vassoura mágica.

Name: Deathtrap
ShortDescription: Orcs Must Die! Deathtrap combines chaotic third-person combat with devious trap-laying strategy. Enjoy endless replayability as your War Mage grows stronger through roguelite progression. Repel relentless orc hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

Name: From the Depths
ShortDescription: Over 1000 unique components allow you to build and command voxel vehicles from the deep ocean to outer space! Forge strategies, allegiances and fleets strong enough to destroy eight deadly factions of the planet and reign supreme. A genre-defying mashup of simulation, building, RTS and RPG.

Name: The Last of Us: Part I
ShortDescription: Descobre o jogo premiado que inspirou a aclamada série televisiva. Guia Joel e Ellie por uma América pós-apocalíptica e encontra aliados e inimigos inesquecíveis em TLOU™.

Name: Grand Theft Auto Vice City
ShortDescription: De volta aos anos 80. A década dos cabeludos de fato cor pastel conta a história da ascensão de um homem ao topo da pirâmide do crime. O Tommy Vercetti está de volta para uma história de traição e vingança numa cidade tropical infestada de néon. Aqui não falta nada e as oportunidades são infinitas.

Name: The Great War: Western Front
ShortDescription: The Great War: Western Front é o derradeiro jogo de estratégia da Primeira Guerra Mundial. Assume o comando na icónica Frente Ocidental de 1914 a 1919 com esta experiência tática em tempo real. Escolhe a tua fação e leva as tuas tropas à vitória.

Name: SurrounDead
ShortDescription: SurrounDead is an open world survival game. Taking place in a world ravaged by an apocalyptic catastrophe. The dead reign free and will stop at nothing to kill you.

Name: The Killing Antidote
ShortDescription: This is a TPS game. Shooting, fighting, dress-up, puzzle solving, and more. In the future, a special germ causes humans to be constantly infected and mutated. The protagonist, Jodi, is a brave journalist who goes on her way to find the legendary antidote and is in danger.

Name: Eyes of War
ShortDescription: Eyes of War is a real-time strategy game set in the medieval era, offering both single-player and multiplayer experiences where you can control every unit in character mode. Build your castle, lead your army, and dominate the map. Eyes of War invites you to epic battles of the medieval era!

Name: Little Misfortune
ShortDescription: Led by her new friend, Mr. Voice, Misfortune ventures into the woods, where mysteries are unraveled and a little bad luck unfolds.

Name: Metro: Last Light Redux
ShortDescription: It is the year 2034. Beneath the ruins of post-apocalyptic Moscow, in the tunnels of the Metro, the remnants of mankind are besieged by deadly threats from outside – and within. Mutants stalk the catacombs beneath the desolate surface, and hunt amidst the poisoned skies above.

Name: Inside the Backrooms
ShortDescription: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

Name: Iron Meat
ShortDescription: Iron Meat is a run-and-gun arcade shooter that immerses players in an apocalyptic future overrun by "The Meat," an iron-ravenous mass mutating everything in its path. Blast your way through retro-inspired stages and bosses to uncover the shocking horrors behind secret experiments on the Moon.

Name: Anomaly Agent
ShortDescription: ANOMALY AGENT é um platformer cyberpunk de ação com combate fluído, uma história pelo tempo, personagens peculiares e uma banda sonora synthwave envolvente! Luta e dispara contra hordas de inimigos, influencia a história com as tuas escolhas e põe fim às anomalias antes que o mundo mergulhe no caos!

Name: God of War (2018)
ShortDescription: Com a vingança contra os deuses do Olimpo enterrada há anos no passado, Kratos vive agora como um homem mortal num reino de deuses e monstros nórdicos. É neste mundo duro e impiedoso que ele tem de lutar para sobreviver... e ensinar o seu filho a fazer o mesmo.

Name: Remnant: From The Ashes
ShortDescription: The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. As one of the last remnants of humanity, you must set out alone or alongside up to two other survivors to face down hordes of deadly enemies to try to carve a foothold, rebuild, and retake what was lost.

Name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE
ShortDescription: Aceita o desafio e junta-te à caça! Torna-te caçador, explora novos mapas e usa uma variedade de armas para derrotar monstros temíveis num enredo totalmente novo, no mais recente episódio da galardoada série Monster Hunter: Monster Hunter Rise.

Name: Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit
ShortDescription: Survive five nights of terror in this chilling adventure game. Travel between time periods to solve puzzles, gather clues, and outrun the threat relentlessly pursuing you. Move swiftly and stay hidden, and you may just survive. But be careful—it's not just your own life that’s on the line this time.

Name: Stranded Deep
ShortDescription: Take the role of a plane crash survivor stranded somewhere in the Pacific Ocean. Come face to face with some of the most life threatening scenarios that will result in a different experience each time you play. Scavenge. Discover. Survive.

Name: EA SPORTS™ FIFA 23
ShortDescription: O FIFA 23 traz o World's Game para dentro de campo, com a Tecnologia HyperMotion2, torneios FIFA World Cup™ masculino e feminino, equipas de clubes femininos, cross-play** e muito mais.

Name: SimRail The Railway Simulator
ShortDescription: SimRail is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.

Name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ
ShortDescription: O DRAGON BALL FighterZ nasce daquilo que torna a série DRAGON BALL tão amada: lutas espetaculares e intermináveis entre poderosos lutadores. Em parceria com a Arc System Works, o jogo maximiza o grafismo de estilo anime e apresenta uma jogabilidade fácil de aprender, mas difícil de dominar.

Name: NARUTO: Ultimate Ninja STORM
ShortDescription: NARUTO: Ultimate Ninja STORM permite que os jogadores combatam através de enormes cenários em 3D. Os jogadores poderão libertar poderosos ataques jutsu, efetuar manobras acrobáticas evasivas e até correr pelas paredes acima. NARUTO: Ultimate Ninja STORM foi remasterizado em HD.

Name: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 2
ShortDescription: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja STORM 2 apresenta-te todas as emoções de Naruto como nunca sentiste antes. O jogo é uma recriação impressionante do universo do anime e acompanha os jogadores através do arco de história Shippuden. Ultimate Ninja STORM 2 foi remasterizado em HD.

Name: NARUTO SHIPPUDEN: Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 Full Burst HD
ShortDescription: Live the 4th Great Ninja War and its overpowering boss fights or defy your friends in ultra dynamic online and offline ninja confrontations!

Name: Soulstice
ShortDescription: Explora um mundo sombrio repleto de mistérios ocultos, domina um sistema de combate distinto e usa o duplo poder de Briar e Lute enquanto amadurecem numa história de fantasia com ação frenética, inimigos violentos e lutas contra bosses de cortar a respiração.

Name: Library of Ruina
ShortDescription: "May you find your book in this place." Combat between the guests and the librarians breaks out as if it were on a stage. Defeated guests turn into books, and the Library grows onward. And eventually, get your hands on… The one singular, perfect book.

Name: Terra Invicta
ShortDescription: An alien invasion has fractured humanity into seven ideological factions each with a unique vision for the future. Lead your chosen faction to take control of Earth’s nations, expand across the Solar System, and battle enemy fleets in tactical combat.

Name: Ghost of Tsushima: Director’s Cut
ShortDescription: Vem aí uma tempestade. Aventura-te em Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT no PC; forja o teu caminho neste jogo de ação e aventura em mundo aberto e desvenda as suas maravilhas ocultas. Da Sucker Punch Productions, Nixxes Software e PlayStation Studios.

Name: Hogwarts Legacy
ShortDescription: O Hogwarts Legacy é um RPG de ação imersivo e de mundo aberto. Agora podes assumir o controlo da ação e estar no centro da tua própria aventura no mundo da feitiçaria.

Name: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
ShortDescription: Assassin's Creed Valhalla é um jogo de ação e aventura em que você é um guerreiro viking que cresceu em meio a histórias de batalhas e glória. Explore um mundo aberto dinâmico, ambientado na Idade das Trevas na Inglaterra.

Name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH
ShortDescription: KOF ’97 is the final entry in the Orochi Saga, the original storyline of the KOF series, which is still played by enthusiastic fans around the world. KOF ’97 makes a return with new features such as online matchmaking, a new gallery mode, and custom menu BGM settings!

Name: Neon White
ShortDescription: Neon White é um jogo de plataformas de ação na primeira pessoa incrivelmente rápido com os portões do Céu como cenário.

Name: Chained in the Backrooms
ShortDescription: Inside the Backrooms is a horror multiplayer game mixed with different mechanics that will make you spend an intense night with friends. Explore, think, interact, but be careful, it is rumored that there are several entities wishing to find you...

Name: Hello Neighbor
ShortDescription: Hello Neighbor é um jogo de terror em que invades a casa do teu vizinho para descobrir os segredos que ele esconde na cave. Joga contra uma IA avançada que aprende os teus movimentos. Gostas de trepar às janelas? Espera uma armadilha para ursos. Estás a tentar fugir? Ele vai arranjar um atalho.

Name: F1® 22
ShortDescription: Entra na nova era da Formula 1® no EA SPORTS™ F1® 22 o videojogo oficial do 2022 FIA Formula One World Championship™.

Name: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition
ShortDescription: Halo Wars: Definitive Edition is an enhanced version of the real-time strategy classic, Halo Wars, updated to run natively on PC. Halo Wars: Definitive Edition includes improved graphics, new achievements and all of the DLC created for the landmark real-time strategy game.

Name: LEGO Indiana Jones: The Original Adventures
ShortDescription: Build, Battle and Brawl your way out of trouble! Play through all three classic Indiana Jones™ movies and relive your favorite Indy adventures in the tongue-in-cheek worlds of LEGO®. Explore and Discover - Battle enemies, solve puzzles, and seek out the world's greatest treasures.

Name: LEGO Indiana Jones 2: The Adventure Continues
ShortDescription: LEGO® Indy is back in his biggest adventure yet. Battle through all four movies, including all-new levels from the original adventures and your favorite new moments from The Kingdom of the Crystal Skull... or in true LEGO® fashion, get creative and build your own levels to play with friends!

Name: Balatro
ShortDescription: O roguelike de póquer. Balatro é um jogo de construção de baralhos de cartas hipnoticamente satisfatório onde vais jogar mãos de póquer ilegais, descobrir jóqueres que vão mudar o rumo do jogo e fazer combinações empolgantes.

Name: Vector
ShortDescription: A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

Name: It Takes Two
ShortDescription: Entra na caminhada mais louca da tua vida em It Takes Two. Convida um amigo para jogar gratuitamente com o Passe de Amigo* e trabalha em conjunto em toda a variedade de desafios de jogo alegres e inquietantes.

Name: FINAL FANTASY XVI
ShortDescription: An epic dark fantasy where fates are decided by mighty Eikons and the Dominants who wield them. This is the tale of Clive Rosfield, a tragic warrior who swears revenge on the Dark Eikon Ifrit, a mysterious entity that leaves naught but calamity in its wake.

Name: King of Retail
ShortDescription: Build a retail empire across dozens of locations with hundreds of employees. Design every inch of your stores with a deep building tool, then fine-tune pricing, staffing, and product mix to stay profitable. Scale up, customize everything, and manage the details that make or break your bottom line.

Name: Chernobylite 2: Exclusion Zone
ShortDescription: Explore the mysterious, beautiful, yet dark world of the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone in this post-apocalyptic action-RPG. Make your mark on this world, through your character development, choices and playstyle. But remember – everything has a price and consequences.

Name: Amenti
ShortDescription: A photographer enters the Great Pyramids to photograph Pharaoh Rudamon’s remains, but is soon overwhelmed by a sinister curse, as the ancient tomb awakens dark forces that claw at his sanity.

Name: OMSI 2: Steam Edition
ShortDescription: Off to the next round! Experience a new omnibus simulator with OMSI 2 and start discovering Spandau while driving the omnibus. OMSI 2 is the successor of the well-known and awarded omnibus simulator "OMSI - The Bus Simulator".

Name: Darksiders II Deathinitive Edition
ShortDescription: The ultimate DARKSIDERS II experience! 1080p native resolution. Reworked and tuned game balancing and loot distribution. Improved Graphic Render Engine for even higher visual quality, lighting and shadows. Improved and reworked level, character and environment graphics.

Name: DOOM Eternal
ShortDescription: Os exércitos do Inferno invadiram a Terra. Torna-te o Slayer numa campanha épica para jogador individual e vence os demónios em várias dimensões para impedir a destruição da humanidade. A única coisa que eles temem... és tu.

Name: SchoolBoy Runaway
ShortDescription: “Seu pestinha! Vai estudar suas lições agora mesmo!” disseram os pais zangados, colocando você de castigo em casa. Tente enganar seus pais e encontre uma maneira de se divertir com os amigos.

Name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
ShortDescription: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping the city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant, expansive world in this standalone entry of the FFVII remake trilogy.

Name: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4
ShortDescription: ONE PIECE: PIRATE WARRIORS 4 é a mais recente evolução do PIRATE WARRIORS! Para que sintas que estás numa batalha do ONE PIECE, os edifícios são destruídos e os ataques lançam pó e fumo para que vejas todos os detalhes do mundo de ONE PIECE!

Name: God of War: Ragnarök
ShortDescription: Kratos e Atreus embarcam numa viagem mítica em busca de respostas antes da chegada do Ragnarök — agora no PC.

Name: DYNASTY WARRIORS: ORIGINS
ShortDescription: Mergulha em batalhas estimulantes na pele de um herói sem nome nos Três Reinos

Name: Forza Motorsport
ShortDescription: Supera a concorrência no Modo Carreira. Corre à volta do mundo no Modo Multijogador. Compete com mais de 500 carros em 27 pistas mundialmentea famosas - agora com a estimulante Nürburgring Nordschleif!

Name: Hitman: World of Assassination
ShortDescription: Entra no mundo do derradeiro assassino a soldo. HITMAN World of Assassination junta o melhor de HITMAN, HITMAN 2 e HITMAN 3, e inclui a campanha principal e os modos Contract (Contrato), Escalation (Agravamento), Elusive Target Arcades (Arcadas de Alvo Difícil) e HITMAN: Freelancer.

Name: Avowed
ShortDescription: Avowed is a first-person fantasy RPG set in the world of Eora, where your choices carve a path through war, intrigue, and ancient mysteries. Navigate a land in turmoil, forge powerful alliances or deadly rivalries, and wield magic and steel to shape the fate of the Living Lands—and your own destiny.

Name: Human Fall Flat
ShortDescription: Human Fall Flat é um hilariante jogo de plataformas em paisagens flutuantes para jogar a solo ou com até 8 jogadores online. Novos níveis grátis ajudam a recompensar a sua comunidade vibrante.

Name: Biped
ShortDescription: Biped is a coop action adventure game with a strong focus on moment-to-moment collaboration between 2 players.

Name: Pizza Possum
ShortDescription: Vive os teus sonhos de gambá num caótico jogo arcada onde o objetivo é comer tudo o que conseguires sem que te apanhem, a solo ou no modo cooperativo local.

Name: Bread & Fred
ShortDescription: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

Name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles
